activeIssue.title: THE FARMER
activeIssue.summary: Opened from the active Greed Lord file. New scenes can be unlocked here as they drop on X.
activeIssue.coverIntro: Start with the cover, then enter the transmission scene by scene.

scenes.title: SOMETHING IS WRONG.
scenes.body: The Trenches struggle below while the machine above keeps growing.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop overlooking the Trenches

scenes.title: THE MACHINE GREW.
scenes.body: That wasn't a coincidence. Loop follows the flow toward its source.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Trenches below the factory

scenes.title: IT WASN'T A FACTORY.
scenes.body: Everything taken from the Trenches flowed through here. It was a farm.
scenes.ariaLabel: The central Loop Gaiden factory

scenes.title: THE FARMER.
scenes.body: He owns the machine. He owns the flow. He always needs more.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Farmer revealed in his vault

scenes.title: THE STORY MOVES.
scenes.body: The first file keeps opening. Every answer points toward another locked door.
scenes.ariaLabel: The story continues in the Trenches

scenes.title: THE FARM IS NOT DONE.
scenes.body: The Trenches are still sending fragments. Loop follows the signal deeper.
scenes.ariaLabel: The sixth Loop Gaiden comic scene

scenes.title: LOOP PUSHES THROUGH.
scenes.body: The Farmer's system fights back, but Loop keeps moving toward the heart of the machine.
scenes.ariaLabel: The seventh Loop Gaiden comic scene

scenes.title: THE TRENCHES WAKE UP.
scenes.body: The farm can feel the resistance now. Every stolen signal starts pointing back at the Greed Lord.
scenes.ariaLabel: The eighth Loop Gaiden comic scene

scenes.title: NO MORE HARVEST.
scenes.body: Loop closes in as the Farmer's control begins to crack across the Trenches.
scenes.ariaLabel: The ninth Loop Gaiden comic scene

scenes.title: THE LOOP CONTINUES.
scenes.body: Issue 001 is complete. The first Greed Lord file is open, and the next signal is already calling.
scenes.ariaLabel: The tenth Loop Gaiden comic scene

nextIssue.title: THE EXTRACTOR
nextIssue.summary: The Farmer was only the beginning. The next Greed Lord file opens with The Extractor.
nextIssue.coverIntro: The Extractor has been found. Enter the next transmission scene by scene.
nextIssue.shareText: Issue 002: The Extractor signal has been found.

scenes.title: THE EXTRACTOR
scenes.body: A new mystery begins beneath the trenches. Loop finds the first sign of The Extractor feeding in the dark.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Extractor opening scene

scenes.title: THE FARMER WAS ONLY THE BEGINNING.
scenes.body: Something else has been feeding on the trenches. Loop just found the trail.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers a new trail beyond the Farmer

scenes.title: MEET THE EXTRACTOR.
scenes.body: The trail opens into a huge cinematic reveal of the Greed Lord behind the drain workers.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop meets The Extractor

scenes.title: CONFRONTATION.
scenes.body: Loop finally faces The Extractor as the drain workers close in and the next Greed Lord file turns dangerous.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop confronts The Extractor

scenes.title: DESTROY THE NETWORK.
scenes.body: Loop tears into the network pipes feeding The Extractor, turning the drain into a major combat sequence.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop destroys the network pipes feeding The Extractor

scenes.title: THE LAST PIPE.
scenes.body: The network was dead... almost. One connection was still alive.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop finds the last live network pipe

scenes.title: HIGHER UP.
scenes.body: Loop looked up. The stolen value was not staying here... it was being sent higher.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop sees the stolen value being sent higher

scenes.title: SOMEONE WAS WATCHING.
scenes.body: And at the other end... someone was waiting. Watching everything.
scenes.ariaLabel: Someone watches Loop from the other end of the signal

openIssues.title: THE MANIPULATOR
openIssues.summary: The signal climbs higher. The next Greed Lord file opens with The Manipulator.
openIssues.coverIntro: The trail led higher. Someone had been watching everything.
openIssues.shareText: Issue 003: The Manipulator file is opening.

scenes.title: THE WATCHER.
scenes.body: The trail led higher. And someone had been watching everything.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Watcher follows Loop from above

scenes.title: THE NARRATIVE.
scenes.body: He did not follow the hype. He controlled it.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Manipulator controls the narrative
